articles.summary: Not everyone wants to be interviewed. Storyworth storytellers can answer each weekly question by email, edit any story, swap questions and keep it all private.
articles.title: Storyworth Without Voice Recording: Writing Options (2026)

articles.summary: Nothing expires if the Storyworth year ends unfinished. Stories stay editable, photos can still be added, and the book prints whenever the storyteller is ready.
articles.title: What Happens If They Don't Finish Storyworth in a Year?
